directive:
Material whole-paper scope improvement required by the D0 maximality audit. Re-author and re-prove the paper over the following faithful superclass; do not merely relabel the existing half-disc result.

1. Replace the main class by an unknown-design, bivariate Lipschitz boundary class: assignment is sharp across any known boundary through b; Y(t) is Bernoulli with mean μ_t(x); each μ_t extends to b, lies in [1/4,3/4], and is L-Lipschitz in Euclidean x on the corresponding side near b; and for a fixed class constant c₀>0 the design obeys P(T=t, ‖X-b‖<H) ≥ c₀ H² for both t and all H≤1/2. The released observation remains EXACTLY Z_Δ=(Y,T,Δ floor(‖X-b‖/Δ)); X, angle, and raw radius are unavailable. State all needed support/locality details explicitly without assuming a known density or radial outcome regression.

2. Rework achievability using observed counts N_t and successes S_t inside the quantizer-aligned neighborhood Q_Δ(R)<H, H=Δ ceil(n^(-1/4)/Δ). Use S_t/N_t for N_t>0 with a fixed clipped fallback for N_t=0. Conditional on N_t, justify the Bernoulli local-average law; bound bias by LH and sampling error using inverse-count/Chernoff bounds under the local-mass assumption. Prove uniform absolute risk O(H+(nH²)^(-1/2)) and squared risk O(H²+(nH²)^(-1)), hence max{n^(-1/4),Δ} and its square.

3. Rework the total honest interval using conditional-count Clopper–Pearson intervals for S_t|N_t, [0,1] on N_t=0, enlargement by LH on each side, and differencing. Prove honest coverage for every sample and expected length O(max{n^(-1/4),Δ}) via count concentration/inverse moments. Correct the minimax expected-length codomain to [0,∞), and explicitly make the honest procedures closed bounded interval-valued maps.

4. For every lower result, retain the current uniform half-disc radial Bernoulli laws only as an embedded least-favorable subclass of the new class. The existing one-pair perturbation g(r)=κ{(h-r)_+ + Δφ(r/Δ)1(r<Δ)} supplies the same-class sampling-plus-aliasing lower bound in that subclass and therefore transfers to the superclass. Do NOT claim φ-orthogonality or exact aliasing for every unknown design. Explain the subclass→superclass minimax and honest-length transfer explicitly.

5. Rename/reframe prop:exact-radius-reduction as a fine-quantization regime result. Cattaneo–Titiunik–Yu is only a rate/method sanity comparator for a different observed-score/Hölder/uniform-along-boundary class, not the same theorem; Dong, Kolesár–Rothe, Armstrong–Kolesár, and Dong–Kolesár likewise do not subsume this latent annular observation experiment. Remove the old technical limitation that incorrectly denies the subclass scope transfer.

6. SYNC ALL PROSE FIELDS to the revised headline and proof: tldr; project_justification.gap/niche/fill; related_work; comparator table; honest_scope; technical_internal_limitation; theorem labels/descriptions; and consumer text. Lead with the frontier over the unknown-design bivariate Lipschitz boundary class and say the uniform half-disc is used only as the least-favorable subclass. Preserve exact observation/coarsening language and do not overclaim exact aliasing for every admissible design.

This is a material scope extension under standard assumptions, not permission to strengthen assumptions to encode the result. Preserve the proved rate, all-Δ totality, and the single-pair combined lower construction. Re-prove every affected node and keep dependencies honest.

Define P as the one-unit law of the primitive tuple (X,Y(0),Y(1)); treatment T and observed Y are induced later by sharp assignment and consistency. Set sym:P refs exactly to ["X","Y(0)","Y(1)"], so the symbol graph no longer has the circular dependency P -> T -> mathcal X_{t,P} -> P. Keep the symbol name P, type "one-unit primitive-data law", space "laws of ((X,Y(0),Y(1)))", role "model", and definition "A one-unit law for the latent score and potential outcomes; treatment and the observed outcome are induced by sharp assignment and consistency." Preserve all other accepted proposal content and provisional proofs. Reopen rather than promote the provisional proofs for thm:honest-length-lower and prop:fine-quantization-regimes so they can be re-solved after the graph lands. Produce a new canonical proposal packet whose assembled postimage passes the structural gate, including the same-round c_0, N_{t,n,Delta}, and mu_t symbol additions needed by lem:conditional-local-binomial-law.
